title: KCP space_access_widen_prepare request (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 access-widening prepare family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Prepares a SpaceAccessWidening: args carry only the proposal deltas; Kovee pins the exact affected frontiers/item-set, classification join, current Space revision, and destination project audience (§10.2 spelled; gap note KG17). The exact Space revision travels as meta.expected_revision (§11.2). Widening the Space never declassifies an object (§10.2). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / authenticated steward/owner principal (assurance: current login; policy may require step-up). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

args.description: Proposal deltas only (§10.2 field names verbatim); prior_*, affected_frontier_refs, digests, subject_digest, and prepared_by_principal are server-derived (gap notes KG5/KG17).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

spaceVisibility.description: Closed Space.visibility enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed). restricted additionally requires an active SpaceParticipant (§10.2).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
